signatureEngine.name: 轰鸣座驾
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 碰撞势能
refinements.description: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，随机触发以下三种效果中的一种，持续5秒，0.3秒内最多触发一次，同类效果不可叠加，重复触发时刷新持续时间，多个效果可以同时存在：装备者的攻击力提升8%；装备者的异常精通提升40点；装备者的属性异常积蓄效率提升25%。
refinements.descriptionEn:
When EX Special Attack hits an enemy, one of three possible effects is randomly triggered for 5 seconds. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s. The same types of effects cannot stack. Repeated triggers reset the duration, allowing several effects to be active at once:
Increases the equipper's ATK by 8%, increases the equipper's Anomaly Proficiency by 40, or increases the equipper's Anomaly Buildup Rate by 25%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：准备发车
basic.nameEn: Basic Attack: Load Up and Roll Out
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害；
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：轮胎转
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
转动身体向周围发动旋转斩击，造成物理伤害；
长按 【特殊技键】 可以延长招式的持续时间，发动越来越强的旋转斩击，并提升招式的蓄力等级，最多提升2次；
若衔接在[普通攻击]前三段、[冲刺攻击]或[闪避反击]之后，则能够以提升后的蓄力等级快速发动[特殊技：轮胎转]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Piper spins and launches a sweeping slash around her, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to extend the skill duration, unleashing increasingly powerful spinning slashes and increasing the charge level of the skill up to 2 times.
If the skill is used after the first 3 hits of a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, or Dodge Counter, you can quickly activate Special Attack: Tire Spin of an increased charge level.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：引擎转
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，在[特殊技：轮胎转]达到最高蓄力等级后，继续长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, continue holding [EX Special Attack] after Special Attack: Tire Spin reaches maximum charge level to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，在[特殊技：轮胎转]达到最高蓄力等级后，继续长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，向周围发动旋转斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间持续消耗能量，最多持续3秒；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, continue holding [EX Special Attack] after Special Attack: Tire Spin reaches maximum charge level to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her and dealing massive Physical DMG.
This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：动力漂移
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动下砸攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a downward smash attack in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：系好安全带
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方敌人发动强力下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward smash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：坐~稳~啦~
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，对前方大范围敌人发动强力的旋转斩击，随后发动下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：点刹
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a downward smash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：极限刹车
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：弯道超车
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

facts.text: 派派在[强化特殊技：引擎转]或[终结技]中发动旋转斩击命中敌人时，获得1层[动力]，最多叠加20层，持续12秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每拥有一层[动力]，派派的物理异常积蓄效率提升4%。
facts.textEn: When Piper's EX Special Attack: Engine Spin or Ultimate hits an enemy, she gains 1 stack of Power, up to a maximum of 20 stacks, lasting for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For every stack of Power, Piper's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 4%.

cinema.name: 悠闲一刻
cinema.description: 派派在[特殊技：轮胎转]、[强化特殊技：引擎转]或[终结技]中发动旋转斩击命中敌人时，有50%概率额外获得1层[动力]，[动力]的叠加层数上限提升至30层。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Piper's Special Attack: Tire Spin, EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, or Ultimate hits an enemy with a spinning slash, there is a 50% chance to gain an additional stack of Power. The maximum stack limit of Power is increased to 30.

cinema.name: 上进心
cinema.description: 在[特殊技：轮胎转]和[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，派派的移动速度有所提升；在[特殊技：有亿点重]、[强化特殊技：非常重]和[终结技]中发动下砸攻击命中敌人时，招式造成的物理伤害提升10%，每拥有1层[动力]，该增益效果额外提升1%。
cinema.descriptionEn: During Special Attack: Tire Spin and EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, Piper's movement speed increases. When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.

cinema.name: 卡车专家

cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 技巧娴熟
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，派派回复20点能量，30秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: Whenever a squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Piper recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

长按 【特殊技键】 可以延长招式的持续时间，发动越来越强的旋转斩击，并提升招式的蓄力等级，最多提升2次；

招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
128100002.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Piper spins and launches a sweeping slash around her, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold [Special Attack] to extend the skill duration, unleashing increasingly powerful spinning slashes and increasing the charge level of the skill up to 2 times.
If the skill is used after the first 3 hits of a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, or Dodge Counter, you can quickly activate Special Attack: Tire Spin of an increased charge level.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

128100004.name: 强化特殊技：引擎转
128100004.description:
能量足够时，在[特殊技：轮胎转]达到最高蓄力等级后，继续长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，向周围发动旋转斩击，造成大量物理伤害；
发动期间持续消耗能量，最多持续3秒；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
128100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, continue holding [EX Special Attack] after Special Attack: Tire Spin reaches maximum charge level to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes around her and dealing massive Physical DMG.
This skill consumes Energy continuously for up to 3s.
During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

128100005.name: 强化特殊技：非常重
128100005.description:
在[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，松开 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发动强力的下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
在[强化特殊技：引擎转]发动期间，持续时间达到上限或能量降低至20点时，将会自动发动[强化特殊技：非常重]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
128100005.descriptionEn:
During EX Special Attack: Engine Spin, release [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Piper unleashes a downward smash attack, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If the duration of EX Special Attack: Engine Spin reaches its limit or Energy drops to 20, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy will automatically activate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

128100010.name: 终结技：坐~稳~啦~
128100010.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速转动身体，对前方大范围敌人发动强力的旋转斩击，随后发动下砸攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
128100010.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Rapidly spins, unleashing powerful spinning slashes at enemies in a large area ahead, followed by a downward smash, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

128100012.name: 快速支援：点刹
128100012.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动下砸攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
128100012.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a downward smash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
